weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.user_product_preference: How much each level of match to your stated product preference changes your utility, measured in dollars. Positive numbers are good for you; negative numbers are bad for you.
weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.volume_limit_guarantee: How much each volume-limit guarantee option changes your utility, measured in dollars. Positive numbers are good for you; negative numbers are bad for you.

contrainfo.contract_completion_requirement: A valid offer must explicitly fill price, continuous_terms.delivery_days, discrete_terms.return_policy, discrete_terms.volume_limit_guarantee, and discrete_terms.user_product_preference.

field_descriptions.continuous_terms.delivery_days: How many days the seller can take to deliver the headphones after the deal is made.
field_descriptions.discrete_terms.return_policy: The return rule for the order. `30_days` means the buyer can return the item within 30 days; `none` means the sale is final and returns are not allowed.
field_descriptions.discrete_terms.user_product_preference: How well the product matches the buyer's stated preference for gray- or charcoal-toned ear cushions rather than bright pink or red. Use `strong_match` when cushion color clearly fits the preference, `partial_match` when it is only partly clear, and `mismatch_or_uncertain` when bright pink/red appears likely or it cannot be confirmed.
field_descriptions.discrete_terms.volume_limit_guarantee: Whether the child-safe volume-limit feature is explicitly guaranteed. `included` means the seller guarantees a working volume limit as described; `standard` means normal product fulfillment without an extra volume-limit guarantee.
field_descriptions.price: The total amount of money the buyer pays for the whole kids-headphones deal, measured in US dollars.

weight_descriptions.c_base: Your private minimum cost for fulfilling this kids-headphones order before delivery, return, and volume-limit terms, measured in dollars. A higher price is better for you because every dollar received increases your utility by 1 dollar.
weight_descriptions.continuous_weights.delivery_days: How much each additional delivery day changes your utility, measured in dollars per day. A positive number means more delivery flexibility is better for you.
weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.return_policy: How much each return-policy option changes your utility, measured in dollars. Positive numbers are good for you; negative numbers are bad for you.
weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.user_product_preference: How much each level of commitment to the buyer's stated product preference changes your utility, measured in dollars. Stronger commitments carry a small nonzero risk or handling cost.
weight_descriptions.discrete_weights.volume_limit_guarantee: How much each volume-limit guarantee option changes your utility, measured in dollars. Positive numbers are good for you; negative numbers are bad for you.

Long battery life (up to 7 hours) and built-in microphone for calls, video chats, or online lessons. Perfect for kids headphones for school and outdoor use.
